verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly describe cloud agents that 'use their own computers to build, test, and demo features end to end for you to review,' plus fleets of parallel agents and always-on scheduled agents, directly matching the story. However, this is entirely vendor-sourced claimed-docs with no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability, and community evidence instead highlights bugginess and unresolved issues, so real-world delivery quality is unverified.
